messages:
erin: Heads up — we're doing a staggered NVLink firmware roll + node reboots in az3 tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC. Expect brief 2–7min evictions per node during drain. Details below.

sourav: what's the expected impact on dedicated pools? any policy for pinned capacity?

erin: Dedicated pools: we'll exclude reserved pools labeled 'no-drain'. Affected: az3 GPU pool-4 (A100-p4dn). Expect ~5% throughput loss during backfills, brief capacity gaps per wave.

lucas: can we route critical low-latency production to eu-region for the window?

erin: yes — smart-routing rule 'az-preemptive' will prefer eu for requests with latency target <50ms. Ops will bump route weight pre-window.

maria: will this trigger model fallbacks? need to ensure model variant availability in eu.

erin: confirmed. model-team preregistered variants; deploy-bot validated images and replicas in eu.

deploy-bot: precheck OK: all variants built, registry image v1.9.2 available, artifact checksums match.

oncall-bot: @here Preflight checklist: KV-cache snapshot, drain template, backfill capacity +10%. Run commands below during window.

oncall-bot: ```
# drain commands (k8s)
kubectl cordon node-az3-*-gpu
kubectl drain node-az3-*-gpu --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

erin: Plan: 4 waves, ~15 nodes/wave, 30m between waves. Each node reboot target <7min end-to-end. We'll watch token-level p50/p99 and eviction rates. If p99 >200ms for >2min we pause.

sourav: cost question — routing to eu will increase egress for model weights; rough estimate +$2k for the window. Can we cap?

erin: set egress cap policy $1500/day for the tenant group; if cap hits, traffic falls back to local cheap-quant models (lower accuracy) to avoid overspend. Ops has the fallback list.

janet: I'll be oncall for waves 1–2 (02:00–03:00 UTC). lucas can you take waves 3–4?

lucas: yep. I'll monitor datadog dashboards/traces and sit by for escalations.

maria: reminder — disable autoscaler surge for affected pools so we don't overprovision and blow the cap.

erin: noted. Ops will push the staging run at 23:00 UTC tonight (dry-run).

sourav: any special log grep pattern to watch for NVLink flaps we should wire into alerts?

erin: yes — grep for: "nvlink.*link error|nvlink.*timeout" in /var/log/nvlink.log and dmesg. We have a helper: `/opt/infra/tools/nvlink-monitor.sh --since 5m` that posts to #eng-infra.

oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-az3-nvlink-maint-1725501122

deploy-bot: Rolling reboot job scheduled: job-id rb-2024-1725501122 (ETA 02:05 UTC). Prechecks passed.

maria: ack. After each wave I'll run the smoke: `check-inference-latency --percentile 99` and post results.

erin: If anything unexpected, mark node as do-not-backfill and escalate to eng-sre. Keep notes in the incident channel. :thumbsup:
